notes.title: New game is GO
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's been about 6 months now since Disparity released on Steam, and I've finally started writing a weekly devlog for my new game Darknasia. It's a greyscale, 8-bit roguelike with a big focus on exploration and survival.

It's got some pretty unique concepts, such as being able to permanently purchase the randomised item buffs you find in areas, store and deposit money between runs, buy expansions to the town on the surface to get access to new shops, and much much more.

You can read more about it here along with a full list of features:
https://tamationgames.itch.io/darknasia

Here's the first devlog I've written about the development process of it:
https://tamationgames.itch.io/darknasia/devlog/29635/darknasia-devlog-1-scratching-the-surface

If you're excited for this new game, please help spread the news about it around social media. You can check my Twitter account for frequent updates on the process of the game.

Thanks for enjoying my games!

notes.title: Disparity Releases
notes.content:
Disparity is finally out on Steam.

This is a game I've been working on since 2015. The original Disparity was completed in Decemeber 2015, though was never officially released. In January this year I began recreating the game from scratch with new graphics, redesigned levels, more polished and smooth feeling gameplay, overhauled the storyline and gameplay mechanics and reached out to the incredibly talented TomboFry to remaster the soundtrack. This is the end result.

It's by far my longest and most polished game and I'm very happy with the end result. 
If any small bugs or issues are found while playing you can post about them in the community hub and I'll fix them all as soon as possible.

Thanks to everyone who's been supporting me and looking forward to this game since I announced it in February. It means a lot to me that I've been able to release this.
